summary: Quiet residential kerb where cars park, but houses sit 11 to 15 m behind.

best_section.where: North kerb of Neulans Road, opposite the tennis court

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 11-14 m behind the kerb on its own side; tennis court and a house across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed residential street with parked cars on the north kerb; room for a van beside them.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked along the north kerb in the imagery.

flags: Dwellings 10-25 m on the same side
sun_shade: Open; street trees on the south side give some afternoon shade.
